name: Dr. F. Harck
mentions: The Marquise de Mores, Miss Thomas and Mr. and Mrs. Whitmore, of New York and Mr. Harck, of Germany, came in Friday night on the Marquis' car, Montana.
Dr. F. Harck, of Germany, who has been visiting here as the guest of Marquis de Mores, left for the Yellowstone Park Sunday evening. From there he goes to San Francisco via Portland,…
